name: OpenSanctions
tagline: Consolidated global sanctions, PEPs, and watchlist matching API
description: OpenSanctions provides a consolidated API for global sanctions lists, politically exposed persons (PEPs), and watchlist screening for AML and compliance workflows. It offers entity search, matching, and bulk data access across multiple official sources.

auth.details: API key authentication; exact header and signup flow need verification from official docs

use_cases: screen a person or company against global sanctions lists
match customer data against PEPs and watchlists
look up an entity by OpenSanctions ID
bulk-export sanctioned entities for offline screening
